name: Keszthely (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Keszthely (a blue shield with a yellow lion, a bird and a wavy stripe within a yellow baroque frame with a ship crest) above the name KESZTHELY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Keszthely arms with frame and crest
